title: Marlowe Rewards Tiers and the Deposit Percentage on Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Replacements
content:
**Benefit.** On a replacement of a Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Deposit Pre-Order, the replacement deposit percentage follows the customer's Marlowe Rewards tier:

| Marlowe Rewards membership | Replacement deposit percentage |
|---|---|
| Active Icon or Atelier member | 10 |
| Active Gold or Platinum member | 15 |

For every other customer, membership does not change the replacement deposit percentage.

**Record read.** The tier and status of the customer's Marlowe Rewards membership. No length of enrolment is required: holding the tier while the membership is active is enough.

**Combinations (hypothetical members)**

| Membership | Replacement deposit percentage |
|---|---|
| Active Atelier, enrolled 3 months | 10 |
| Active Gold, enrolled 10 years | 15 |
| Active Silver | Not changed by membership |
| Closed Platinum | Not changed by membership |
